185 --- Page 7 --- KI JINGIATHUHKHANA NA KA JUTANG BARIM --- Page 9 --- Kine barob ki la iurol pyndonburon ia u Blei.
KABA THAW IA KA PYRTHEI MYNDANC-NYNGKONG ym shym la don ei-ei kaba la thaw.U Blei Uba la don junom naduh bymjukut, U la thaw ia ka bneng bad ia ka khyndew.
Baroh ka la dum tiw-tiw.
Te u Blei U la ong: "To long ka jingshai." Bad ka jingshai ka la long.
U Blei U la pyniakhlad ia kata ka jingshai na kata ka jingdum.
U la khot ia kata ka bashai: ka sngi; bad ia kata ka badum: ka miet.
Ia ka khyndew la tap lin da ka um.
Kumta u Blei U la pyn.
iakhlad ia ka um na ka ryngkew.
Ha ka khyndew U la pymmih ia u phlang, ki jhur ki jhep, bad ia ki dieng baseisoh.

Ynda kumta u Blei U Ja thaw ia ka sngi, ia u bnai bad ia ki khlur, bad U la buh ia ki ha sahit-bneng; ha ka suin U la buh ia ki sim, ha ki pung bad ha ki wah U la buh ia ki dohkha; bad ha ka khyndew ia ki mrad ki mreng, ha la ka jait bad shijur shijur.
Ha kaba khatduh u Blei U la thaw ia u briew; uwei u --- Page 10 --- briew uba kyrteng u Adam bad kawei ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Im.
Kine baroh ki la iaroh pyndonburom ia u Blei, bad ki la sngewnguh, ba U la thaw ia ki bad ia ka sahit-bneng bad ia ka sngi, ia ka khyndew, ia ki sim bad ia ki dieng baseisoh.
KI ANGEL NALOR kine, u Blei U la thaw ruh bun bah ki Angel, ki mynsiem kibym don met kum mangi ki briew.
U la ai ha ki, ki jingaiei bakordor bad U la pynlong ia ki, ki bakhraw tam na ki para jingthaw baroh.

Byllien ki la ri ia la ka jingkhuid bad jingluilui kaba u Blei U la ai, hynrei katto katne napdeng jong ki, ki la hap ha ka pop baiap jong ka jingsarong, namar ki la U Mikbael Bakbuid ryngkat bad kiwei pat ki Angel babha u la shop arsut shapob dujok-ding ia u Lusipber bad ia ki nongbud barob.
